title: A relationship credential issued in one app verifies in another
summary: Each side hands the other a DTG RelationshipCredential it issued. The receiving side verifies the proof, the context and the issuer scope with its own library and states the result.
waitingOn: a run with live-issued credentials, and a third project

sides.version: geb, VRCs in DTG WD 0.6.0 form (Oct 2026)

results.note: Vectors both ways. Consensual's independent DI-EDDSA verifier confirmed RLTP's encounter credentials (8 Oct). RLTP's reader verified 12 of 12 Consensual dyad VRCs under did:peer:2 after six form fixes on their side (11 Oct); the run surfaced a key-purpose check fixed in trust-protocol #74. Consensual's vectors are not public yet.
